answer: Behaviour-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. Permissions stay locked until behaviour matches its baseline; registration alone is a fable. Low-stakes tasks record timing, counterparts. Actions must echo it: a match unlocks the next tier, deviation freezes it. Like karst, a fingerprint is carved by slow flow, not faked overnight. One fake costs 60 POA; 100 cost 6,000, burned on detection. Honest agents pay once, then earn it back.
